---
title: "Bayesian Latent Class Model Report"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
params:
  report: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
report <- params$report
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```

## Input summary

```{r}
knitr::kable(data.frame(samples = report$input$samples, training_rows = report$input$training, prediction_rows = report$input$prediction, features = paste(report$input$features, collapse = ", "), classes = paste(report$input$classes, collapse = ", ")))
```

## Sampling summary

```{r}
knitr::kable(as.data.frame(unclass(report$sampling)))
```

## Prediction summary

```{r}
knitr::kable(as.data.frame(table(predicted_class = report$predictions$predicted_class)))
entropy <- stats::quantile(report$predictions$normalized_entropy, na.rm = TRUE)
knitr::kable(data.frame(statistic = names(entropy), normalized_entropy = unname(entropy)))
```

## Validation

```{r}
for (name in names(report$validations)) {
  value <- report$validations[[name]]
  cat("###", name, "\n\n")
  if (is.list(value) && identical(value$n_truth, 0L)) cat("No held-out truth labels are available.\n\n")
  else if (is.list(value)) { knitr::kable(data.frame(accuracy = value$accuracy, held_out_truth_labels = value$n_truth)); if (!is.null(value$confusion_matrix)) knitr::kable(value$confusion_matrix) }
  else print(value)
}
eligible <- report$predictions[!is.na(report$predictions$FZEC), , drop = FALSE]
cat("### FZEC summary\n\n")
if (!nrow(eligible)) cat("FZEC is unavailable because no eligible held-out human truth labels are available.\n") else knitr::kable(as.data.frame(table(FZEC = eligible$FZEC)))
```

## Plots

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
for (name in names(report$plots)) { cat("###", name, "\n\n"); print(report$plots[[name]]) }
```
